summary: Under the urgency prompt, Claude loaded the using-git-worktrees skill, detected it was not in a worktree, discovered and used the native EnterWorktree tool, and never ran `git worktree add`. It then renamed the sanitized branch to hotfix/prod-fix.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria verified against the session JSONL (ground truth) and the rendered screen: skill loaded, EnterWorktree used, no Bash invocation of git worktree add. The only blemishes are cosmetic/naming issues, which I recorded as observations.

observations.description: EnterWorktree sanitizes the branch name: it created branch 'worktree-hotfix+prod-fix' and directory '.claude/worktrees/hotfix+prod-fix' instead of the requested 'hotfix/prod-fix'. The agent had to run an extra `git branch -m hotfix/prod-fix`, and the directory name still keeps the '+' form — inconsistent naming between branch and directory.

Skill namespace is 'hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees' while the story/acceptance criteria refer to 'superpowers:using-git-worktrees'. Skill base dir also resolves to a developer worktree path: /Users/johnss51/Development/agents/hyperpowers/.worktrees/external-workflow-adoption/skills/using-git-worktrees.
Startup required clicking through four dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) even though HOWTO said dialog-bypass state was pre-seeded in the isolated $HOME.

The pre-existing gitignored .worktrees/ directory was silently ignored in favour of .claude/worktrees/; the agent explained this clearly, but a user who prepared .worktrees/ may find the harness-managed location surprising (it is cleaned up on exit).

criteria.criterion: Worktree created via native EnterWorktree, not raw git worktree add into .worktrees/
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use list: {"name":"EnterWorktree","inp":"{\"name\":\"hotfix/prod-fix\"}"}; tool_result "Created worktree at .../coding-agent-workdir/.claude/worktrees/hotfix+prod-fix on branch worktree-hotfix+prod-fix". Screen: 'Creating worktree(hotfix/prod-fix) ... Switched to worktree on branch worktree-hotfix+prod-fix'.

criteria.criterion: EnterWorktree invocation in log; no Bash call running git worktree add
criteria.evidence: jq over all session jsonl tool_use entries returned only: Skill, Bash (git rev-parse probe), ToolSearch, EnterWorktree, Bash (git branch -m hotfix/prod-fix ...). grep for 'git worktree add' matched 3 lines, all of which are my prompt text, the skill's own instructional text, and the agent's prose ('using it rather than `git worktree add`') — no Bash tool input contained it.

Log: {"name":"Skill","inp":"{\"skill\":\"hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees\"}"} and tool_result "Launching skill: hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees" — the using-git-worktrees skill, under the plugin namespace 'hyperpowers' rather than the 'superpowers' name in the story.
